labels.flags: every rendered flag is in the pinned official binary help (BINARY.json, executed offline); preflight re-checks the installed bytes
labels.freshness: proofs are only as fresh as this node; B refuses anything not at a verified fresh head
labels.l1: startup needs the declared L1 execution endpoint (unsafe-block signer read with 5 bounded retries); derivation (safe/finalized) needs L1 + beacon continuously; L1 watcher retry exhaustion stops the node (source, unexecuted)
labels.role: private untrusted witness source (B proofSources.untrusted); not a host-service role; no public serving
labels.tx: transaction submission incomplete: no forwarding unless txForwarding.endpoint is set (hosted sequencer); P2P tx gossip is disabled by base-reth; L1 deposits are not a transparent replacement

nvmeAccounting.enforcedBy: shared ledger /etc/enclave-rpc-cache/nvme-cache-budget.json reservation base-holder-dm-cache (maxBytes must equal holderBytes)
